original_test_intent: Validate each Type 19 Ending Address as the inclusive last boundary of the correct mapped physical-memory-array range, using the appropriate legacy or extended representation and remaining stable after reboot.
original_method: Collect complete Type 16/19/20 and OS-map evidence, gate legacy versus Extended Ending Address by sentinel/length, pair it with the same record's start, normalize inclusive units, resolve the array, validate all ranges, and repeat after reboot.
manual_activity: A user supplies the approved range/inclusive-end policy and reboot approval; no memory remapping or physical action is required.
required_inputs: SMBIOS version and Type 19 structure length
Legacy sentinel, extended-field, unit and inclusive-end rules
Expected ranges per Type 16 array with allowed gaps/overlaps
safety_requirements: Use read-only SMBIOS/OS map queries; never alter memory mapping, kernel, DIMMs or firmware.
Pair end with the same record's start and reject mixed legacy/extended sentinel modes.
Preserve raw values; handle inclusive-end conversion and overflow explicitly.
Require reboot approval and recovery; stop on invalid topology or boot failure and do not auto-retry.
agent_execution_scope: Resolve each ending boundary with paired start, encoding mode, array handle, Type 20/OS map and full range topology before and after reboot.
Report inverted, overlapping, mixed-mode or drifting ranges without issuing PASS/FAIL.
engineer_actions: Approve range, reservation, inclusive-boundary and cross-map expectations plus reboot plan.
Resolve intentional address reservations and issue the verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The label is relevant but grep -A1 omits paired start, inclusive boundary arithmetic, encoding mode, array link and map topology.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Archive full raw/decoded Type 16/19/20 plus OS map and report per handle raw legacy/extended start/end, normalized inclusive range, array link, topology checks and pre/post diff.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The Ending Address scope, Type 19 script and 5/5-minute values are retained; no mapping change is added.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Select the valid ending representation by sentinel/length, pair it with the same start, normalize inclusive boundary units, resolve the array and validate the complete map before and after reboot.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: SMBIOS systems exposing Type 19 mapped ranges.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record SMBIOS, firmware, parser/dmidecode and OS-map versions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Applicable SMBIOS Type 19 legacy/extended inclusive endpoint and Type 16/20 relationship definitions.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds paired start, inclusive arithmetic, encoding selection and full-map correlation.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Detects off-by-one capacity, mixed sentinels, inverted/overlapping ranges and invalid array links missed by text grep.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Approved map, inclusive-end and reservation policy.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: OS maps may contain intentional reservations; nonidentity requires interpretation, not automatic failure.

project_override_considerations: Projects may define target-specific ranges and reserved holes, but cannot change Type 19 inclusive-end or encoding semantics; overrides must identify the expected full map.
expected_evidence: Approved range, encoding/unit, inclusive-end, gap/overlap and OS-correlation policy
Complete pre-reboot raw Type 16/19/20 records with lengths/versions
Per-range raw legacy/extended endpoints, normalized inclusive range and array handle
Approved reboot/health evidence and post-reboot map diff

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Ending Address is a valid Type 19 field; expected map values are project inputs.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Endpoint decoding, topology validation and reboot comparison are automatable after inputs.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Retains full-map safeguards while restoring FULLY AUTOMATABLE classification.

review_improvement: Prevents a plausible end string from hiding off-by-one, inverted, mixed-mode or wrong-array ranges.
independent_technical_reasoning: The ending field's unique risk is inclusive boundary arithmetic; complete range parsing is deterministic and read-only.
